analysis.summary: Sonam Limited reported a significant increase in revenue and net profit for the first half of FY27, driven by strong domestic demand, raw material sourcing advantages, and trading activities. Management highlighted that freight costs for exports have risen, leading to a shift in focus toward the domestic market and premium wall clock models. The company targets higher revenues and PAT for the full year and aims to achieve a PAT of Rs. 25 crores to Rs. 30 crores by 2028-2029.

guidance.claim: Management expects turnover to increase by 30% to 40% more than expected in the next two quarters along with an increase in margins.
guidance.quote: And secondly, as you said, in the next two quarters, we hope that the turnover will increase by 30% to 40% more than what we expected. And the margin will also increase.

guidance.claim: Management's target is to provide maximum benefit to shareholders till 2028, 2029 and achieve a PAT of Rs. 25 crore to Rs. 30 crore with an EPS of Rs. 5 to Rs. 6.
guidance.quote: Our plan is to provide maximum benefit to shareholders till 2028, 2029 and do PAT of Rs. 25 crore to Rs. 30 crore. And our EPS becomes Rs. 5 to Rs. 6.

guidance.claim: Management projects that profit will grow by 40% to 50% regardless of fluctuations in EBITDA margin.
guidance.quote: But our profit will grow by 40%, 50% in any way.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the full-year growth guidance is expected to be 25% to 30%.
guidance.quote: you have given the guidance that full-year guidance will be 25% to 30% growth. Is this pace sustainable throughout the rest of the year or was due to Q1 boosted by one of the factors?

guidance.claim: Management expressed hope that the 25% to 30% growth will be sustained due to new product line-ups.
guidance.quote: Yes, we hope that 25% to 30% growth will be sustained. We have launched a lot of new products and there is a new line-up of new products.

guidance.claim: Management projected that revenue for the next quarter will be around Rs. 40 crores to Rs. 50 crores minimum.
guidance.quote: For the next quarter we hope that revenue will be around Rs. 40 crores to Rs. 50 crores minimum.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that growth is coming more from the domestic market.
demand_outlook.quote: Actually, our growth is coming more from domestic.

demand_outlook.claim: The company experienced increased demand in the domestic market due to the development of numerous new models and distribution channel expansion.
demand_outlook.quote: It is because of that. And the second thing is that according to domestic, we have developed a lot of models. So according to that, we have got a good response.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the first quarter experienced deadly demand across the product portfolio.
demand_outlook.quote: The 1st Quarter of FY’27 has been an increasing start to the financial year, reflecting strong operational performance, deadly demand across our product portfolio and our continuing commitment to innovation and customer satisfaction.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the positive market response to new products strengthens confidence in the long-term growth strategy.
demand_outlook.quote: The positive market response to this new product has been encouraging and strengthens our confidence in our long-term growth strategy.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that export is going down due to the increase in price.
demand_outlook.quote: There is a little bit impact on export because export is going down due to the increase in price.

margins_costs.claim: During half-year FY27, the EBITDA margin stood at 6.7% compared with 7.73% in the corresponding period of the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: Our EBITDA margin stood at 6.7% compared with 7.73% in the corresponding period last year.

margins_costs.claim: The PAT margin improved to 3.3% from 3.18%, representing an improvement of 0.25% points.
margins_costs.quote: Our PAT margin also improved to 3.3% from 3.18%, representing an improvement of 0.25% points.

margins_costs.claim: Imported goods carry an average operating margin of 3% to 4%, while trading and manufacturing activities have a gross profit of 21%.
margins_costs.quote: Actually, in imported goods, we have an average margin of 3% to 4% and the average margin in trading activity and in manufacturing activity, there is 21% gross profit.

margins_costs.claim: The company benefited from an increase in crude oil prices, which resulted in a good profit in raw materials purchased and sold.
margins_costs.quote: But as the price of crude oil increased in the market, according to that we have a good profit in raw material. The raw material that we purchase and sell here, has a good margin and turnover is also very good.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin stood at 6.07% for H1 FY27 compared with 7.73% in the corresponding period last year.
margins_costs.quote: Our EBITDA margin stood at 6.07%, compared with 7.73% in the corresponding period last year.

margins_costs.claim: The company reported an EBITDA margin of 8.06% and a PAT margin of 4.49% for Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: The company reported an EBITDA margin of 8.06% and a PAT margin of 4.49%, reflecting our continued focus on operation efficiency, disciplined cost management and sustainable profitability.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that margin is fluctuating a bit due to daily raw material price increases and decreases.
margins_costs.quote: Margin side is fluctuating because daily raw material price is increasing and decreasing. So, the margin is fluctuating a bit.

orders_capacity.claim: The current capacity utilization of the company stands at 52%.
orders_capacity.quote: The capacity utilization for now is 52%.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that the capacity utilization is 60% to 70% on a quarter-to-quarter basis.

capital_allocation.claim: Dividend paid including corporate dividend tax was ₹120.10 lakhs for the period ended 30-09-2026.
Management stated there are no requirements for additional borrowing currently to fund future growth.

risks_headwinds.claim: Freight costs increased in exports, which negatively impacted export volumes and manufacturing-level figures.
risks_headwinds.quote: Actually this year freight cost has increased in export. So, according to that export is a little less. There is an effect on export. Accordingly, it is a little less at the manufacturing level.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted there is not much impact from geopolitical situations or war on operations.
risks_headwinds.quote: No, there is not that much impact.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the company will launch eight to ten new models in the coming two to three months.
management_commitments.quote: And we have launched a lot of new models in these two months. And in the coming two, three months we will launch eight to ten new models.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to provide maximum benefit to shareholders and achieve a PAT of Rs. 25 crore to Rs. 30 crore by 2028-2029.
management_commitments.quote: Our plan is to provide maximum benefit to shareholders till 2028, 2029 and do PAT of Rs. 25 crore to Rs. 30 crore.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated plans to develop and sell clocks in the range of Rs. 5,000 to Rs. 10,000 in the years 2027-28.
management_commitments.quote: So, our segment, our market planning is we will sell clock in the range of Rs. 5,000 to Rs. 10,000 and develop such items in this year, 2027-28.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
